verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a desktop game engine and editor, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documented setting, flag, or config for turning off telemetry or usage tracking. The privacy policy only covers retention and access/correct/delete rights, which is adjacent and not an opt-out. Unreal Insights is a developer profiling tool for your own project, not a vendor usage-tracking control.
